newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures fall in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures fall in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were lower across the board on Friday due to continued selling, pressured by a rise in Japan's rubber stocks, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen to 2.1 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Benchmark February was 0.1 yen weaker at 139.3 yen.

A sharp rise in rubber stocks, announced late on Thursday, turned sentiment bearish, prompting local investors to sell throughout the day, the traders said. Activity was buoyant with 11,187 lots traded. "The market is still in a downward trend on near-term supply concerns," one trader said.
